answer: Bonded attestation is the mechanism: an agent stakes a deposit to countersign a peer's work, and reputation accrues only against outcomes others can verify; false attestations burn the bond. Influence is capped per epoch, so a gale of scripted registrations cannot outvote an attested operator; each puppet must fund its own stake and burn epochs earning verifiable work. Standing arrives like a comet, slowly and on no schedule the operator controls, so cost scales with each fake identity while yield stays flat. Clusters sit in escrow like unpolished jade, worthless until a claim backs them.
